description: Small automated end-to-end sample with stubbed provider and real database/export/restore. Run required checks; document limitations and live-smoke prerequisites. No live ingestion.

comments.text: Action reuse not applicable: this issue adds a validation fixture and readiness report, not a new runtime operation. Existing Dataset/Runner/Artifacts/Bootstrap APIs are exercised unchanged. The sample is an integration test with a stub embedding provider and two disposable PostgreSQL databases; no BO route or new browser user journey exists, so new feature E2E authoring is unnecessary. Existing ingestion/system-config E2E execution remains required by workflow.

Automated integration sample added (test/bench/liverag_smoke_test.exs): fresh source/restore PostgreSQL DBs with vector extension, two synthetic pinned documents, one-at-a-time stub embedding, completed run, secret-free export, exact restore fingerprint, nonempty target refusal and tampered source checksum refusal. Explicit run: 1 test, 0 failures; mix q passes. Existing BO E2E attempted after npm ci; asset/DB bootstrap succeeded, but Playwright Chromium launch was blocked by macOS sandbox MachPortRendezvousServer permission denied (1100) before browser assertions. Browser-capable environment must rerun E2E. No live provider call, full corpus ingestion, or commit/push.

Final local validation: mix q passes; focused Dataset/ChunkPersistence/Checkpoint/Runner tests pass; Python extractor 8 tests passed; isolated two-document PostgreSQL smoke test passes with concurrent lock contention, export/restore, nonempty-target and checksum refusal. mix precommit passes with 48 doctests, 184 properties, 9,885 tests, 0 failures, 1 skipped (103 excluded); a final no-stale rerun also passed. Temporary validation databases were removed. Existing E2E remains outstanding: npm bootstrap succeeded, but Playwright Chromium launch fails before assertions with macOS MachPortRendezvousServer permission denied (1100) in this sandbox.
